letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every sunset in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up even the hottest desert evenings. I cherish our late‑night chai talks, the way you dance in the kitchen, and the gentle way you hold my hand during our weekend getaways. Today feels extra magical, as if the world is winking at us—just another reason to love you more, cutie.
poem:
In dunes of gold or city’s glow,  
Your love’s the breeze that makes me whole.  
Across two homes, our hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
